cover.headline:
One Notion your team
and your agents trust.
cover.lede: A three-phase plan to organize Biomed's Notion so you, Chris, Elizabeth and your Grok agents all work from the same place, done before the end of the year. Based on our conversations on October 29 and November 10.

glance.p: The structure your agents will read from and write to.

glance.h: Architecture, context layer, tasks and team
glance.p: Three phases in about four weeks.
On a new workspace, at no cost.

context.title:
What we
heard.
context.lede: Biomed is a three-person recruitment agency moving to Grok as its central AI. Recruiterflow stays as the ATS, but everything else is spread across Planner, SharePoint, OneDrive, OneNote and a new Notion workspace, and the agents can only be as good as the place they read from.

stats.t: tools holding tasks, files and notes today

pains.p: Ten years of notes, plus SharePoint and OneDrive, with no clear rule for what lives where. Grok can't find what nobody can find.

pains.h: Every new job starts in Planner
pains.p: Assigning tasks to Chris and Elizabeth for each new role is done by hand, and Planner doesn't talk to Grok.
Chris and Elizabeth aren't on Notion yet, so the system only works for one person.

quote.text: I do like how Grok can just pull things without me going into Notion, but I also wanna keep Notion organized and clean, too.

context.opportunity: You're about to build agents for recruiting, metrics and sales. If Notion is organized first, every agent starts with the right context instead of each one needing its own fix later.

focus.title:
Where we'd
start.
focus.statement: One organized Notion that both your team and your Grok agents work from: every task, document and decision in one known place. You mentioned a lot of good ideas. We'd start with the foundation they all depend on.
asked: Organize Notion, with personal and private space
Notion as the brain for Grok
Task assignment for every new job
Clean up OneNote, SharePoint and OneDrive
Agents for recruiting, sales and finance
recommend: Clean architecture, with personal and team spaces
Context layer the Grok agents point to
Task workflow for new jobs, plus team training
Notion and Loom meetings in one place
Metrics and agents next, once the foundation is in place
focus.why: Recruiterflow's metrics aren't reliable yet, so a dashboard built now would show the wrong numbers. Agents built on an organized Notion will need less rework later.

proposal.title:
Three phases,
one price.
proposal.intro: Each phase has its own price and they add up to one fixed total. The tags show what the project needs and what we advise.

phases.name: Audit and architecture
phases.summary: We review what's there today and design a structure that's easy to navigate for people and for agents.
deliverables: Audit report of your current workspace and the blueprint you received: what to keep, change or archive
New workspace with teamspaces, with separate personal and team sections
Your current Notion content moved into the new workspace, and unused pages and databases archived
Migration guide for OneNote, SharePoint and OneDrive: what moves to Notion, what stays, and how to move it

phases.name: Context layer for Grok
phases.summary: The databases and rules your Grok agents read from, so they know where to find and where to put things.
deliverables: Agent operating guide adapted to Biomed (rules, approvals, archive instead of delete)
Skills, memory and resources databases in their own teamspace
Setup sheet for each agent with the database IDs and instructions to paste in

phases.name: Tasks, meetings and team
phases.summary: Your Planner workflow moved to Notion, meetings in one place, and Chris and Elizabeth trained to use it.
deliverables: Task board with a template for each new job that assigns tasks to Chris and Elizabeth
Personal portal for each team member
Meetings database with your Notion and Loom recordings
Team guide: how to use the workspace day to day

included: Weekly working sessions during the build
3 months of Notion Business on a new workspace, at no cost
excluded: n8n automations and other integrations (defined in the roadmap, subject to technical feasibility)
Moving files from OneNote, SharePoint or OneDrive (the migration guide shows you how)
Notion licenses after the bonus period
proposal.guarantee: One month after delivery to fix issues within the delivered scope, at no extra cost.

payment.schedule: 50% when you accept, 50% on delivery. By bank transfer, or by card through Stripe with a 4% card fee.

next_steps.p: Right here, below. By bank transfer or card.
We send you the link to book the kickoff and set up the new workspace.
Done before the end of the year.

closing:
We're ready to build
your Eureka moment.
